look_for: extra/missing/fused fingers or toes;unnatural finger joints;hands merging into objects;broken nail/finger geometry;limbs that start/end inconsistently
recommended_method: detect human/animal regions;crop hands/feet at native resolution and 100% view;vision-language structured review;optional pose/keypoint consistency check
decision: REVIEW by default; BLOCK only after the defect is clearly confirmed and materially harms quality.

look_for: melted or misaligned eyes/pupils;inconsistent teeth or mouth geometry;ears/jaw/nostrils deformed without artistic intent;facial parts merged with hair, glasses or clothing
recommended_method: face/landmark detection if reliable;close-up crop of face at 100%;VLM comparison of local geometry and context
decision: REVIEW; judge according to intended style and whether an actual defect is visible.

look_for: wrong limb count/attachment;malformed paws/hooves/beaks/wings;eyes or joints that do not fit the species;implausible contact with ground or objects
recommended_method: animal detection and region crop;species-aware VLM questions;check multiple viewpoints/visible anatomy only

look_for: fused parts;impossible joins;duplicated/missing components;unclosed or melted silhouettes;perspective inconsistencies that look like defects;object parts changing material/shape without reason
recommended_method: object-region detection;VLM part-by-part inspection;compare object function and visible connections;crop suspicious junctions
decision: REVIEW; do not infer copyright/IP status solely from visual defect detection.

look_for: unintended gibberish/pseudo-text;unreadable text in prominent areas;letters morphing into texture;duplicate/garbled signs or labels
recommended_method: OCR across full image;OCR/vision on detected text regions;VLM assess if text is intended and legible
decision: REVIEW. If branded/logo/IP phrase is detected, also run IP checks.

look_for: main subject is soft/out of focus;unintended motion blur;important details softened;oversharpening halos or crunchy edges
recommended_method: measure sharpness over image and subject ROI separately;native-resolution/100% crop review;Laplacian variance or edge-energy only as a calibrated signal
decision: BLOCK only for confirmed unusable technical issue; otherwise REVIEW.

look_for: highlight clipping losing key detail;shadow clipping obscuring key subject detail;uneven/unnatural lighting;exposure inconsistent with intended subject
recommended_method: histogram and channel-clipping metrics;local exposure map;vision review for intended high-key/low-key styles
decision: REVIEW; hard block only when required detail is clearly lost/unusable.

look_for: unintended color cast;poor white balance;excessive/unnatural saturation;posterization or banding;color fringing/chromatic aberration
recommended_method: inspect neutral regions only where they plausibly exist;histogram/channel comparison;edge-fringe detector;VLM contextual review

look_for: excessive sensor-like noise;compression blocks/ringing;texture smearing;posterization/banding;detail destroyed by denoising
recommended_method: flat-region noise estimate;DCT/block-artifact indicators;crop review at 100%;compare source/upscaled file if supplied
decision: REVIEW; don't auto-reject on noise scores alone.

look_for: oversharpening halos;edge ringing;plastic skin or loss of texture;visible masking/selection errors;clone/heal repetitions;unintended dust spots
recommended_method: edge halo detection;local texture/detail analysis;mask boundary inspection;vision crop review

look_for: shadow directions contradicting light sources;reflections not corresponding to visible objects;floating objects without contextual explanation;contact shadows missing where expected
recommended_method: VLM explain light direction and object support;compare regions of reflective objects;generate annotated crop evidence
decision: REVIEW; internal heuristic, not a standalone enumerated Adobe rule.

look_for: unintentional awkward crop;important subject clipped;unnecessary excessive empty space for isolated PNG;subject not clearly separated for intended use;unlevel horizon where unintended
recommended_method: subject segmentation and subject-to-canvas ratio;rule-based margin measurement for PNG;VLM assess intentionality and use case
decision: REVIEW unless it violates explicit technical/use-case constraints.

look_for: checkerboard baked into pixels;opaque/matte background instead of alpha transparency;white/black fringe or halo;jagged/contaminated cutout edges;unwanted semi-transparent pixels or shadows
recommended_method: verify alpha channel and alpha bounds;composite over light/dark/mid-gray/checkerboard backgrounds;inspect edge crops at 100%;find near-empty margins
decision: BLOCK if no true transparency when transparency is required; REVIEW for halos or intended shadows.

look_for: watermarks, timestamps, logos, branding, wordmarks and visible trademark text;wordmarks, logos, brand labels, packaging, uniforms/insignia, distinctive protected product design, artwork/murals, recognizable locations
recommended_method: OCR and logo detection;object/landmark model;context-aware VLM explanation;cross-check current Adobe Known Restrictions
decision: REVIEW by default; confirmed restriction/policy issue may BLOCK. Never automatically inpaint-and-pass.

look_for: title/keywords claim visible subjects not present;wrong species/material/location/age/person count;metadata includes prohibited IP terms for AI content;AI content mislabeled as 3D render or photograph without basis
recommended_method: vision caption grounded in visible objects;cross-check each key metadata claim against image;entity scan over title/keywords/prompt
decision: REVIEW; correct unsupported metadata before submission.

look_for: visible hateful symbols or text in context;potentially defamatory portrayal or caption relationship;content with sensitive subject matter requiring policy review
recommended_method: OCR and visual concept recognition;context review of full image and associated title/keywords;apply official policy rules, not model preference
decision: REVIEW by default; BLOCK only when the applicable policy violation is confirmed.
